GitHub Actions workflow to build fuzz artifacts and dispatch them to AR Fuzz.

# Purpose
This GitHub Actions workflow publishes fuzzing build outputs for ARFuzz and related tooling. The `solfuzz-build-and-publish` job builds shared objects with and without coverage support, copies source files into the artifact layout, and uploads the resulting `.so` files as GitHub artifacts for later use. The `ARfuzz-publish` job builds fuzz test binaries for the selected machine profile, packages the build directory as an artifact, records the current commit hash, and sends a repository dispatch request to the `FuzzCorp-bundler` service with the artifact ID and metadata needed for bundling. Together, these jobs automate build, packaging, and handoff steps for fuzzing distribution in the codebase.
